name: skills
description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code skills and plugins for enhanced development workflows

plugins.name: fireworks-tech-graph
plugins.description: Create precise SVG technical diagrams (architecture, UML, agent, cloud, workflow), export PNG or offline HTML, and animate supported semantic SVGs to GIF. Trigger: '画图' '架构图' '流程图' 'generate diagram' 'draw diagram' 'visualize'.

plugins.name: handdraw-style-prompter
plugins.description: Turn a 001-263 hand-drawn style number plus an image theme into bilingual (Chinese/English) image prompts, or generate the image with a model-capability-aware decision about passing the numbered reference image. Skill-only package (97MB style reference image library stays upstream at yang0/handraw-style). Trigger: 'handdraw style' '手绘风格' '编号风格' 'style number prompt'.

plugins.name: architecture-diagram
plugins.description: Create professional, dark-themed architecture diagrams as standalone HTML files with inline SVG graphics. Use when asking for system architecture, infrastructure, cloud, security, or network topology diagrams.

plugins.name: odoo-19
plugins.description: Odoo 19 development knowledge base with 19 specialized guides covering Actions, Controllers, Data files, API Decorators, SQL Constraints, Field types, Manifest, Mixins, ORM, Migration, OWL, Performance, QWeb Reports, Security/ACL, Testing, Transactions, Translations, and XML Views.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like 'how do I do X', 'find a skill for X', 'is there a skill that can...', or express interest in extending capabilities.

plugins.name: academy-guide
plugins.description: Recommends matching courses, tutorials, and use cases from Claude Academy (academy.claude.com), Anthropic's learning hub, when answering questions about how to use Claude or a Claude product.

plugins.name: algorithmic-art
plugins.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use when users request generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems.

plugins.name: brand-guidelines
plugins.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any artifact that may benefit from Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use when brand colors, style guidelines, or company design standards apply.

plugins.name: canvas-design
plugins.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy and bundled fonts. Use when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static visual piece.

plugins.name: claude-api
plugins.description: Claude API / Anthropic SDK reference: model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, and model migration. Read before writing or debugging any Claude/Anthropic LLM code.

plugins.name: discernment-nudge
plugins.description: After giving a substantive answer or draft the user may act on, this skill prompts a confidence check and verification of assumptions — surfacing uncertainty before the user relies on the output.

plugins.name: doc-coauthoring
plugins.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation, proposals, technical specs, and decision docs — efficiently transferring context and refining content through iteration.

plugins.name: docx
plugins.description: Create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) and Word templates (.dotx), including professional formatting, tracked changes, and mail merge.

plugins.name: frontend-design-skill
plugins.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one — aesthetic direction, typography, and choices that don't read as templated defaults. (Skill version from anthropics/skills; the fuller frontend-design plugin is listed separately.)

plugins.name: internal-comms
plugins.description: Resources for writing internal communications: status reports, leadership updates, company newsletters, FAQs, and announcements, in the formats companies actually use.

plugins.name: mcp-builder
plugins.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK) that let LLMs interact with external services through well-designed tools.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: Read, extract, combine, split, rotate, watermark, fill forms in, encrypt/decrypt, and create PDF files — full PDF manipulation toolkit.

plugins.name: pptx
plugins.description: Create, read, and edit PowerPoint presentations (.pptx/.potx) — slide decks, pitch decks, template-based generation, and text extraction.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance with evals, benchmarking, and variance analysis.

plugins.name: slack-gif-creator
plugins.description: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack, with constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts.

plugins.name: theme-factory
plugins.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts (slides, docs, reports, HTML landing pages) with a theme — 10 pre-set color/font themes applicable to any artifact, or generate a new theme on-the-fly.

plugins.name: web-artifacts-builder
plugins.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts with React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui — for artifacts requiring state management, routing, or component libraries.

plugins.name: webapp-testing
plugins.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright: verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

plugins.name: xlsx
plugins.description: Open, read, edit, fix, create, and format Excel/spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, .tsv) — formulas, charts, pivot tables, and data cleaning.

plugins.name: android-native-dev
plugins.description: Android native application development and UI design guide: Material Design 3, Kotlin/Compose development, project configuration, accessibility, and build troubleshooting.

plugins.name: buddy-sings
plugins.description: Makes the Claude Code pet (/buddy) sing a song — triggers on any request combining the Claude Code buddy/pet/companion concept with singing or music, in any language.

plugins.name: flutter-dev
plugins.description: Flutter cross-platform development guide: widget patterns, Riverpod/Bloc state management, GoRouter navigation, performance optimization, platform-specific implementations, and testing.

plugins.name: frontend-dev
plugins.description: Full-stack frontend development combining premium UI design, cinematic animations, AI-generated media assets, persuasive copywriting, and visual art for complete, visually striking web pages.

plugins.name: fullstack-dev
plugins.description: Full-stack backend architecture and frontend-backend integration guide: REST APIs, CRUD apps, real-time apps, Express + React, Next.js, database integration, and deployment.

plugins.name: gif-sticker-maker
plugins.description: Convert photos (people, pets, objects, logos) into animated GIF stickers with captions — cartoon stickers, emoji packs, Funko Pop / Pop Mart blind box style animations.

plugins.name: ios-application-dev
plugins.description: iOS application development guide covering UIKit, SnapKit, and SwiftUI: touch targets, safe areas, navigation, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, accessibility, and SwiftUI design guidelines.

plugins.name: minimax-docx
plugins.description: Professional DOCX document creation, editing, and formatting using OpenXML SDK (.NET): create from scratch, fill/edit existing documents, or apply template formatting.

plugins.name: minimax-multimodal-toolkit
plugins.description: Use mmx to generate text, images, video, speech, and music via the MiniMax AI platform from the terminal, including web search and MiniMax API resource management.

plugins.name: minimax-music-gen
plugins.description: Generate music, songs, and audio tracks — music creation, song writing, lyrics generation, covers, or turning provided lyrics/moods into a song.

plugins.name: minimax-music-playlist
plugins.description: Generate personalized music playlists by analyzing the user's music taste and generation feedback history.

plugins.name: minimax-pdf
plugins.description: Create visually polished, design-forward PDF documents — reports, proposals, resumes, client-ready documents where visual quality and design identity matter.

plugins.name: minimax-xlsx
plugins.description: Open, create, read, analyze, edit, and validate Excel/spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv) including financial models and pivot tables.

plugins.name: pptx-generator
plugins.description: Generate, edit, and read PowerPoint presentations: create from scratch with PptxGenJS, edit existing PPTX via XML workflows, or extract text with markitdown.

plugins.name: react-native-dev
plugins.description: React Native and Expo development guide: components, styling, animations, navigation, state management, networking, performance, testing, native capabilities, and CI/CD.

plugins.name: shader-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive GLSL shader techniques for stunning visual effects — ray marching, SDF modeling, fluid simulation, particle systems, procedural generation, lighting, and post-processing.

plugins.name: vision-analysis
plugins.description: Analyze, describe, and extract information from images using the MiniMax vision MCP tool — triggers on shared image file paths/URLs or requests to look at an image.

plugins.name: agent-sdk-dev
plugins.description: Development kit for working with the Claude Agent SDK: verifier agents, commands, and guidance for building SDK applications.

plugins.name: claude-opus-4-5-migration
plugins.description: Migrate your code and prompts from Sonnet 4.x and Opus 4.1 to Opus 4.5.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring to filter false positives.

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Commands for git commit workflows including commit, push, and PR creation.

plugins.name: explanatory-output-style
plugins.description: Adds educational insights about implementation choices and codebase patterns (mimics the deprecated Explanatory output style).

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics. (Plugin version from anthropics/claude-code.)

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Easily create custom hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns or from explicit instructions. Define rules via simple markdown files.

plugins.name: learning-output-style
plugins.description: Interactive learning mode that requests meaningful code contributions at decision points (mimics the unshipped Learning output style).

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive toolkit for developing Claude Code plugins. Includes expert skills covering hooks, MCP integration, commands, agents, and best practices, plus AI-assisted plugin creation and validation agents.

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification.

plugins.name: ralph-wiggum
plugins.description: Interactive self-referential AI loops for iterative development. Claude works on the same task repeatedly, seeing its previous work, until completion.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security reminder hook that warns about potential security issues when editing files, including command injection, XSS, and unsafe code patterns.

plugins.name: pptx-plugin
plugins.description: PowerPoint generation and editing plugin with text-only QA (no vision required). Uses subagents for cover, TOC, content, section divider, summary slides, and template-based PPT editing workflows.

plugins.name: n8n-mcp-skills
plugins.description: Complete bundle: 15 expert skills for building flawless n8n workflows using n8n-mcp MCP server, with a hooks enforcement layer. Includes skills for expression syntax, MCP tools usage, workflow patterns, validation, node configuration, JavaScript code, and Python code.
